name: nepotism

explanation.en: A spouse, partner, kum or family member of someone who leads an organisation holds a job at that same organisation. Each match names the leader, the relative, how they are related and the organisation. A lead for a reporter, not a finding: the appointment may be legitimate. Time: a case whose dates show the two periods never met is dropped. The rest carry a status: "overlapping" when all four dates are recorded and the years meet, "unknown" when any is missing.
explanation.sr: Supružnik, partner, kum ili član porodice osobe koja vodi organizaciju radi u toj istoj organizaciji. Svaki pogodak imenuje rukovodioca, srodnika, vrstu veze i organizaciju. Trag za novinara, ne zaključak: postavljenje može biti opravdano. Vreme: slučaj čiji datumi pokazuju da se periodi nikad nisu dodirnuli se izostavlja. Ostali nose status: "overlapping" kada su sva četiri datuma zabeležena i godine se dodiruju, "unknown" inače.

name: owner-in-office

explanation.en: A person who owns a company, in whole or in part, also holds a position in a government organisation. A possible conflict of interest between the business and the office. Time: a case whose dates show the two periods never met is dropped. The rest carry a status: "overlapping" when all four dates are recorded and the years meet, "unknown" when any is missing.
explanation.sr: Osoba koja je vlasnik ili suvlasnik firme istovremeno ima položaj u državnoj organizaciji. Mogući sukob interesa između posla i funkcije. Vreme: slučaj čiji datumi pokazuju da se periodi nikad nisu dodirnuli se izostavlja. Ostali nose status: "overlapping" kada su sva četiri datuma zabeležena i godine se dodiruju, "unknown" inače.

name: schoolmates-in-power

explanation.en: Two people who went to the same school are both tied, through work or politics, to the same organisation. A pattern worth a second look when the organisation is public or the roles are appointed; shared schooling alone proves nothing. Time: a case whose dates show the two periods never met is dropped. The rest carry a status: "overlapping" when all four dates are recorded and the years meet, "unknown" when any is missing.
explanation.sr: Dve osobe koje su išle u istu školu obe su, kroz posao ili politiku, vezane za istu organizaciju. Obrazac vredan drugog pogleda kada je organizacija javna ili su uloge imenovane; samo zajednička škola ne dokazuje ništa. Vreme: slučaj čiji datumi pokazuju da se periodi nikad nisu dodirnuli se izostavlja. Ostali nose status: "overlapping" kada su sva četiri datuma zabeležena i godine se dodiruju, "unknown" inače.

query:
# Schoolmates in power / Školski drugovi na vlasti
# Two people who went to the same school are both tied, through work or politics, to the same
# organisation. A pattern worth a second look when the organisation is public or the roles are
# appointed; shared schooling alone proves nothing.
# Time: a case whose dates show the two periods never met is dropped. The rest carry a status:
# "overlapping" when all four dates are recorded and the years meet, "unknown" when any is missing.
#
# Dve osobe koje su išle u istu školu obe su, kroz posao ili politiku, vezane za istu
# organizaciju. Obrazac vredan drugog pogleda kada je organizacija javna ili su uloge
# imenovane; samo zajednička škola ne dokazuje ništa.
# Vreme: slučaj čiji datumi pokazuju da se periodi nikad nisu dodirnuli se izostavlja. Ostali nose
# status: "overlapping" kada su sva četiri datuma zabeležena i godine se dodiruju, "unknown" inače.
PREFIX :    <http://poderopedia.com/vocab/>
PREFIX vip: <https://w3id.org/vip/vocab#>
PREFIX bio: <http://purl.org/vocab/bio/0.1/>
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?personA ?personB ?school ?organization ?schoolOverlap ?organizationOverlap
WHERE {
  ?schoolingA a :EducationalConnection ; :hasStudent ?personA ; :hasAcademicOrganization ?school .
  ?schoolingB a :EducationalConnection ; :hasStudent ?personB ; :hasAcademicOrganization ?school .
  FILTER (STR(?personA) < STR(?personB))

  ?tieA bio:participant ?personA, ?organization .
  ?tieB bio:participant ?personB, ?organization .
  { ?tieA a :WorkConnection } UNION { ?tieA a :PoliticalConnection }
  { ?tieB a :WorkConnection } UNION { ?tieB a :PoliticalConnection }
  ?organization a foaf:Organization .
  FILTER (?organization != ?school)

  OPTIONAL { ?schoolingA :connectionStartDate ?schoolAStart }
  OPTIONAL { ?schoolingA :connectionEndDate ?schoolAEnd }
  OPTIONAL { ?schoolingB :connectionStartDate ?schoolBStart }
  OPTIONAL { ?schoolingB :connectionEndDate ?schoolBEnd }
  FILTER (!(BOUND(?schoolAEnd) && BOUND(?schoolBStart) && SUBSTR(STR(?schoolAEnd), 1, 4) < SUBSTR(STR(?schoolBStart), 1, 4)))
  FILTER (!(BOUND(?schoolBEnd) && BOUND(?schoolAStart) && SUBSTR(STR(?schoolBEnd), 1, 4) < SUBSTR(STR(?schoolAStart), 1, 4)))
  BIND (IF(BOUND(?schoolAStart) && BOUND(?schoolAEnd) && BOUND(?schoolBStart) && BOUND(?schoolBEnd), "overlapping", "unknown") AS ?schoolOverlap)

  OPTIONAL { ?tieA :connectionStartDate ?tieAStart }
  OPTIONAL { ?tieA :connectionEndDate ?tieAEnd }
  OPTIONAL { ?tieB :connectionStartDate ?tieBStart }
  OPTIONAL { ?tieB :connectionEndDate ?tieBEnd }
  FILTER (!(BOUND(?tieAEnd) && BOUND(?tieBStart) && SUBSTR(STR(?tieAEnd), 1, 4) < SUBSTR(STR(?tieBStart), 1, 4)))
  FILTER (!(BOUND(?tieBEnd) && BOUND(?tieAStart) && SUBSTR(STR(?tieBEnd), 1, 4) < SUBSTR(STR(?tieAStart), 1, 4)))
  BIND (IF(BOUND(?tieAStart) && BOUND(?tieAEnd) && BOUND(?tieBStart) && BOUND(?tieBEnd), "overlapping", "unknown") AS ?organizationOverlap)
}
ORDER BY ?organization ?personA ?personB
